en: Black‑and‑white view over a calm river or lake with several small rowboats in the foreground. On the opposite bank stand three ornate late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century villas surrounded by dense trees, with forested hills rising behind them. The left villa is light‑colored with a balcony, the middle villa has a decorative tower, and the right villa is a larger brick building with dormer windows. Two of the villas display German‑language names on their façades.
